about: Fairchild Alchemy is a small practice concerned with objects that carry more than their weight. Everything here is either made by hand, printed from geometry, or found and given new context. The name comes from the belief that transformation is the only constant, and that even discarded matter can become something worth holding. Nothing ships in plastic. Everything ships in paper, wrapped as if it matters, because it does.
